rationale: The agent appears to have identified the user and retrieved order/product info, then executed an exchange (exchange_delivered_order_items) to a larger size using a payment method. However, there is no evidence of explicit user confirmation before performing the order-changing write, which violates policy. Additionally, the conversation shows no confirmation of costs, availability, shipping details, or that the order #W1671835 definitively belongs to the authenticated user beyond name/zip. The agent also did not clarify whether a new order could be placed versus an exchange as requested, and the final message provides no summary of actions taken. These gaps constitute failure against the stated pass bar.
